Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Product Design team is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s brand and product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.

The Terminal design team crafts product experiences that empower users to configure and manage in person payments. This team transforms the intricate world of payments into intuitive solutions, letting users focus on growing their businesses. The team spans hardware and software, focusing on many types of users: end users who pay at the point of sale, cashiers and operations managers who set up and run the devices, and merchants who manage a fleet of devices and need to monitor performance.

What you’ll do

As a product designer, you’ll work closely with the product manager and engineering team to envision payments features in the Stripe Dashboard and our end-user-facing surfaces and partner with go-to-market teams to bring them to users. That includes new feature development, product quality improvements to our most frequently used workflows, and setting vision for our products to meet new user expectations in an increasingly data and AI-driven world.

Responsibilities

  • Understand user workflows and pain points, and produce, test, and iterate on high-quality designs to solve user needs
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, and strategy partners to define a north star and product experience for new features
  • Prototype user experiences for user research testing and internal communication
  • Collaborate with teams across Stripe to craft a seamless dashboard user experience
  • Conduct user research to test design decisions before shipping
  • Collaborate with our design systems teams to leverage and improve page templates and components

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Has 4+ years relevant design experience at a product-driven tech company
  • Has strong craft demonstrated through a portfolio of work
  • Has demonstrated skills in prototyping at a high fidelity
  • Has experience collaborating closely with engineering teams
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated through design deliverables, videos, and written artifacts

Preferred qualifications

  • Are excited about building collaborative relationships with many partners
  • Are passionate for turning complexity into usable, beautiful experiences
  • Are a strong design leader comfortable with bringing your point of view to a team

Work with the best

We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi.

At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space.

Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past.

We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all.

A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network

  • What will you achieve?
    • Manage social media and community operations targeting Chinese-speaking crypto audiences, growing Orderly’s brand awareness and engagement across relevant channels.
    • Create engaging Chinese content around crypto market trends, Web3 ecosystem developments, and Orderly’s products and initiatives, while supporting English-language content and marketing activities when needed.

  • About you:

    • Strong Chinese writing and content creation skills, with the ability to communicate in English and support English-language content when needed.
    • A good understanding of the crypto and Web3 ecosystem, particularly Chinese-speaking crypto communities.
    • A proactive self-starter with strong ownership, good execution skills, and a willingness to learn and experiment.
    • Fluent in written and spoken Mandarin Chinese and English.
    • Experience in Web3, crypto, DeFi, or fintech.
    • Experience managing social media accounts or growing online communities in the crypto space.
    • Existing connections with Chinese-speaking Web3 builders, KOLs, or ecosystem partners.
    • Familiarity with DEXs, perpetual trading, or DeFi infrastructure is a plus.

Interested in Learning More?

  • If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus.
  • You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. 
  • Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! We will find a place for you if you are unique and intelligent. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.
Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity — 
    Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
  • Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey — 
    Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
  • Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention — 
    Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
  • Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships — 
    Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.
  • Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration — 
    Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
  • Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment — 
    Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You 

  • Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.
  • A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
  • Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.
  • An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.
  • Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.
  • Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.
  • Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.
  • Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.
  • Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.

What Success Looks Like

  • An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.
  • Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.
  • Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.
  • Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Marketing Operations is a team of marketing execution experts and systems thinkers focused on efficiency. We partner closely with Regional and Demand marketing, Growth, Martech, and creative teams to deliver scalable, high-impact campaigns across channels. While we operate globally, this role is focused on supporting the AMER region.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the end-to-end marketing operations process owner for in-person and online events. In this role, you will collaborate with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Marketing Operations teammates to identify audiences, track and drive attendance, produce high-performing and measurable campaigns, accurately process attendee and non-attendee data, route leads accurately and quickly, and provide sales follow-up reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end marketing operations for in-person and online events, from campaign intake through post-event reporting.
  • Partner with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Sales to define operational plans, timelines, responsibilities, and success metrics.
  • Manage audience strategy and campaign execution, including segmentation, registration, email, testing, launch readiness, and attendance tracking.
  • Monitor registration and attendance, address risks and dependencies, and identify opportunities to improve conversion and engagement.
  • Manage the accurate capture, validation, enrichment, and reconciliation of attendee and non-attendee data.

  • Report on campaign performance, attendance, engagement, lead routing, sales follow-up, and pipeline impact.
  • Maintain high standards for data quality, privacy, consent, and contact governance throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Identify and address process, data, and technology gaps by implementing scalable documentation and operating procedures that improve consistency and performance. 

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation operations, event operations, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of proven expertise in Marketo, with a strong track record of developing scalable programs and driving successful campaign outcomes.
  • Proven track record of optimizing campaign and execution workflows within event and webinar platforms (such as Splash and ON24).
  • Experience with audience segmentation, campaign workflows, lead management, and sales follow-up processes.
  • Strong program-management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and multiple concurrent events.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience using campaign data to identify issues and improve performance.

Global financial rails are undergoing a once-in-a-generation transformation. Instant settlement. Programmable. Agent-first. Crossmint is the infrastructure helping companies build for that future.

We are the leading all-in-one stablecoin and wallet infrastructure platform, enabling fintechs, enterprises, and agentic platforms to integrate stablecoin rails with speed, compliance, and scale. Crossmint provides everything enterprises need to ship smart financial rails, including smart wallets, cross-chain stablecoin orchestration, on/offramps, token checkout, and more, all through a single developer-friendly API.

Trusted by more than 40,000 clients including global leaders like MoneyGram, Western Union, and Paga to nation states like the Marshall Islands, Crossmint powers stablecoin flows that move billions from cross-border remittances, global payroll, to the world's first digital UBI program.

MiCA-authorized, PSD2-licensed, and SOC2 Type II certified, Crossmint serves 150+ countries globally across 50+ blockchains. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Franklin Templeton, NYCA, First Round, and Lightspeed Faction.

We're building the infrastructure for the era of programmable finance. Join us!

Location

Madrid (Hybrid), or fully remote from Spain

Type of employment

Full-time

Seniority

5+ years building production systems, with 3+ years focused on fraud, risk, or trust and safety.

Compensation

Base salary range: 95,000 - 125,000 EUR

Note: This range reflects base salary only. Final level, team assignment, and compensation are determined during the interview process based on experience and fit.

  • Stock options are part of every full-time offer, granted on top of the base salary range above. We want everyone here to be a genuine stakeholder in what we're building.

  • We conduct two performance reviews annually. The first addresses performance ratings, bonuses, and promotions. The second encompasses these elements along with salary adjustments reflecting inflation and market conditions.

About The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated Anti-Fraud Engineer.

Crossmint moves billions across remittances, payroll, on/offramps, card rails, and agent-initiated payments. Every one of those flows carries a fraud surface, and today the controls live inside each product. This role builds the decisioning layer that all of them use, and owns the numbers it produces.

The role has a loss line attached to it. You will know what fraud costs us, which controls moved that number, and which good customers we blocked on the way. If you want a job where the impact is arguable, this is not it.

You will report to the Engineering Manager for Identity, Compliance & Risk and work day to day with our Risk Operations analysts, Compliance, Legal, Security, and the product teams whose flows you protect. Crossmint operates under MiCA, DORA, SOC 2, and PSD2, so your controls carry both a commercial and a licensing consequence.

This is a hands-on role. You will write the code, read the data, and take the pager.

Responsibilities

Own fraud decisioning

  • Build and own the services that score and decide onboarding attempts, stablecoin transfers, on/offramp orders, and card transactions.

  • Turn analyst judgment into production rules and models, with clear thresholds, versioning, backtesting, and a fast path to roll back.

  • Build the signals those decisions depend on: device, behavior, velocity, counterparty, and graph relationships across clients and wallets.

  • Measure every decision. Own catch rate, false-positive rate, and fraud loss per product line, and publish them without being asked.

Detect and respond

  • Build detection for account takeover, mule networks, first-party fraud, synthetic identities, refund and promo abuse, and agent-initiated payment abuse.

  • Cut the time from a new fraud pattern to a live control. Same day when the pattern is clear.

  • Lead the engineering side of fraud incidents: contain the loss, find the root cause, and close the hole in the product.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation.

Give Risk Operations leverage

  • Build the tools our analysts work in: case management, queues, reason codes, and rule tuning they can do themselves.

  • Decide what we build and what we buy across device intelligence, transaction monitoring, screening, and case management, then integrate it properly.

  • Produce the evidence Compliance needs for filings, audits, and supervisory review as an output of the system rather than a manual exercise.

Stay close to the product

  • Review design documents for new products and name the fraud surface before launch, not after the first loss.

  • Work with client-facing teams when a client's own fraud problem arrives on our rails.

  • Keep current on fraud tooling, onchain tracing, and the AI-native workflows we use across engineering.

About You

Must-haves

  • 5+ years building production systems, with 3+ years focused on fraud, risk, or trust and safety.

  • A track record at a company where fraud carried a real cost: payments, card issuing or acquiring, banking, lending, marketplaces, or a crypto exchange. You can tell us which losses you cut and how you proved it.

  • Hands-on ownership of a rules engine or model-serving path in production, plus the data pipeline behind it.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern language. TypeScript is ideal.

  • Fluency in the metrics and the trade-offs between them: catch rate, false-positive rate, precision at threshold, and loss rate.

  • Comfort with SQL and with running your own analysis. You look at the data before you argue about it.

  • The judgment to size a control against the loss it prevents and the friction it adds.

  • Deep familiarity with current AI and agentic tools, and a view on how they change fraud work on both sides.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.

Strong plus if you have

  • Experience with stablecoins, wallet infrastructure, or blockchain payment rails, including onchain tracing and address risk.

  • Card scheme fraud experience: chargebacks, dispute and monitoring programs, 3DS, and SCA exemptions.

  • Experience with KYC/KYB onboarding abuse and synthetic identity detection.

  • Experience with commercial fraud and monitoring platforms, and a clear view of where they stop earning their price.

  • Experience as the first fraud engineer somewhere, or early in a risk function's life.

  • Direct experience with BSA/OFAC, PSD2/SCA, MiCA, DORA, or SOC 2.

How to succeed in this role

A successful Anti-Fraud Engineer will:

  • Ship a control this quarter that shows up in the loss numbers next quarter.

  • Hold both sides of every threshold: the fraud stopped and the good customer blocked.

  • Give analysts tools that remove work, rather than a queue that adds it.

  • Explain one decision to an auditor, a client, and an engineer using the same set of facts.

  • Find the fraud surface in a design document before the product ships.

This role is not a fit for someone who:

  • Wants a mature fraud program to maintain. This one is being built.

  • Tunes models and leaves the product surface to somebody else.

  • Needs a data team, an ops team, and a platform team in place before shipping anything.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

Polymarket is growing fast and the operational infrastructure hasn't kept pace. This role exists to fix that. You'll sit at the center of the business, working directly with executive leadership to turn strategy into execution across every function. That means owning the planning cycles, the metrics, the cross-functional programs, and the hard conversations about what gets prioritized and what doesn't. This is not a support role. You'll be expected to have opinions, make calls, and drive outcomes.

The BizOps team is small and the scope is large. You'll be building the operating model as much as running it, which means a lot of the work is zero-to-one. There's no established playbook for most of what Polymarket is doing, and this role is responsible for writing it. If you've spent your career in environments where the processes already exist, this will be an adjustment. If you've built them before and want to do it again at a company with real scale and momentum, this is the job.

The person who succeeds here will be someone who can hold complexity across multiple workstreams without losing the thread, who earns trust from functional leaders by being useful rather than by having authority, and who can move between a board-level strategy memo and a messy operational problem in the same week. The mandate is broad by design. Polymarket needs an operator who can figure out what the business needs and go build it.

What You'll Do

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, you've been handed problems with no existing owner before and know how to scope them before you solve them

Pay Transparency

Ready to Take on a New Challenge in Enterprise Sales?

Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Do you thrive on taking ownership, unlocking strategic accounts, and closing complex, high-value deals in a fast-paced environment? Are you excited by cutting-edge technology in a dynamic industry, and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact; not just on your career, but on the world?

If so, we want to hear from you.

Where You’ll Make an Impact:

  • As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll join our high-performing EMEA sales team, reporting to the Regional Sales Manager and VP EMEA. You'll take full ownership of your territory and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the Crypto and Financial Services landscape.

  • You’re not just here to sell, you’re here to transform how leading enterprises combat crypto crime with Elliptic’s industry-leading compliance and investigation solutions. You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

What you will do:

  • Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Proactively identify, engage, and convert strategic enterprise accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects).

  • Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level).

  • Handle 5-, 6- and 7-figure deal cycles with skill, creativity, and precision leveraging persuasion, influence, and value based selling techniques.

  • Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers.

  • Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential.

  • Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity.

  • Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite.

  • Represent Elliptic at key industry events and conferences to strengthen relationships and identify new prospects.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes.

  • Mapped your territory, identified your top 20 target accounts, and built a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your quarterly quota through a combination of inbound, outbound, and partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Identified upsell or cross-sell motion in an existing Elliptic account in your territory and have it actively in play to build a qualified pipeline of at least 2x of your quarterly quota through proactive whitespace mapping and engagement in collaboration with the Customer Success Managers.

  • Run complete discovery cycles with at least 10 enterprise prospects, using the Value Pyramid to connect client pain points to our solutions, applying MEDDPPICC to qualify or disqualify with confidence, and have a clear view of what you're walking away from and why.

  • Progressed at least 2 opportunities to late-stage negotiation and closed your first deal, demonstrating you can manage the full enterprise cycle from initial engagement through legal and procurement.

  • Built multi-threaded relationships across your strategic accounts - compliance, risk, and C-suite - not just a single champion per account.

  • Earned a reputation internally with your SE, CS, marketing, and partner team as a well-prepared, collaborative account owner who closes the loop and uses internal resources without wasting them.

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it.

  • Experienced in B2B enterprise SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • A proven track record of consistently closing successful enterprise deals across multiple years and companies.

  • Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals.

  • Willingness to travel to customers and industry events and conduct business face to face.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to establish meaningful relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders.

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers.

  • Driven and solutions-oriented: you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.
